backend/main.mo: Defines core backend actor with storage, access control, and types for customers, invoices, services, work orders, and photos.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping print‑related invoice features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files across routing, components, API utilities, and features.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Provides troubleshooting steps for deployment issues such as stopped‑canister IC0508 errors.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining theme variables, dark mode overrides, and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document loading the React app and providing environment bootstrapping for Internet Identity.
frontend/src/api/backendClient.ts: Normalizes backend errors into structured AppError objects with special handling for stopped‑canister and authorization errors.
frontend/src/api/queryKeys.ts: Centralized factory for React Query cache keys for customers, invoices, services, and work orders.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures React Query and TanStack Router routes including invoice print route and renders the main app shell.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Main layout component providing navigation, authentication controls, and page structure.
frontend/src/components/AsyncState.tsx: Reusable component that displays loading, error, or empty states with optional technical details.
frontend/src/components/BootstrapGate.ts: Gates app rendering behind Internet Identity initialization and shows loading or error states.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Renders the application’s branded header with logo and business title.
frontend/src/components/StartupErrorBoun: Catches startup errors and displays a detailed error screen with reload and copy options.
frontend/src/config/invoiceAssets.ts: Exports static paths and metadata for invoice logo and watermark images.
frontend/src/config/invoiceBranding.ts: Defines static address, payment instructions, and optional text number for invoices.
frontend/src/features/customers/Customer: Dialog that loads and displays detailed customer info and related work orders with error and loading states.
Form for creating or updating customers, including guitar entries and validation.
React page showing a customer list with dialogs for adding, viewing, and editing customers using customer queries.
React Query hooks for fetching, creating, and updating customers and their work orders via the backend actor.
frontend/src/features/customers/types.ts: Defines customer-related form data types and a helper converting customer objects to form data.
frontend/src/features/invoices/blobStora: Implements client-side image upload by converting files to data URLs with progress reporting. Returns display-ready blob URLs.
frontend/src/features/invoices/InvoiceDe: Invoice detail view handling payments, photo uploads, editing, printing, and authentication-gated access.
frontend/src/features/invoices/InvoiceDo: Renders a printable invoice document including business info, customer details, and line items.
frontend/src/features/invoices/InvoiceFo: Form for creating or updating invoices with customer selection, line item editing, validation, and submission.
frontend/src/features/invoices/InvoiceLi: Renders and manages editable invoice line items including service selection, pricing, and totals. Handles adding, removing, and updating items with dynamic calculations.
frontend/src/features/invoices/InvoicePh: Displays a modal dialog showing a full-size preview of an invoice photo. Uses blob storage URLs and closes when the dialog is dismissed.
Provides UI for uploading, previewing, and removing invoice-related photos with validation and progress tracking. Supports preview dialogs and delete confirmation flows.
frontend/src/features/invoices/InvoicePr: Loads invoice data and triggers the browser print dialog once ready. Ensures authentication and renders a printable invoice document.
frontend/src/features/invoices/InvoicesP: Displays a list of invoices with create and edit dialogs, authentication checks, and customer lookups. Provides table actions for viewing and editing individual invoices.
frontend/src/features/invoices/photoType: Defines photo upload state types and validation rules for image type and size. Ensures files meet supported formats and size limits.
frontend/src/features/invoices/queries.t: React Query hooks for fetching, creating, and updating invoices and customers via the backend actor, including currency/percent parsing for line items.
frontend/src/features/invoices/ServiceSe: A searchable popover select component for choosing a service, supporting clearing and highlighting the selected item. Emits selected service IDs to parent components.
frontend/src/features/invoices/SignInReq: Shows a sign-in prompt with Internet Identity when the user is unauthenticated. Provides a button to trigger the login flow.
frontend/src/features/invoices/types.ts: Shared invoice types and helper functions for currency/percent parsing, totals calculation, formatting, and converting invoices to form data.
frontend/src/features/landing/LandingPag: Landing page with navigation cards linking to customers, invoices, work orders, and services.
frontend/src/features/reports/invoiceRep: Utilities to convert invoice timestamps and check whether invoices fall within a specified date range.
frontend/src/features/reports/InvoicesRe: UI component providing filters for invoice reports, including status, customer, and date range selection.
Page fetching invoices and customers, applying report filters, handling auth/loading states, and rendering filtered results.
frontend/src/features/services/importPar: Parses CSV/TSV service rows into structured objects with validation of name and price.
frontend/src/features/services/queries.t: React Query hooks for listing, fetching, creating, updating, and bulk-importing services via backend actor.
frontend/src/features/services/ServiceBu: Dialog component for pasting or uploading CSV/TSV service data, previewing parsed rows, and submitting bulk imports.
frontend/src/features/services/ServiceEd: Form for editing an existing service, handling validation and submit via update mutation.
Page that loads a service by ID and renders the service edit form with navigation controls.
frontend/src/features/services/ServiceIt: Form for creating a new service with validation and submit via create mutation.
frontend/src/features/services/ServicesP: Main services listing page with table, add-service dialog, and bulk import dialog.
frontend/src/features/services/types.ts: Defines service form data and import preview types plus helpers for parsing and formatting currency.
frontend/src/features/workOrders/queries: Defines React Query hooks to list, fetch, create, update, and add photos to work orders using an authenticated actor.
frontend/src/features/workOrders/types.t: Defines the WorkOrder form data structure and helpers to convert between form values and backend input formats.
frontend/src/features/workOrders/WorkOrd: Dialog component for creating a new work order with validation and mutation handling.
Displays and edits a single work order, including status, photos, and customer data with save/update logic.
Manages work order photo uploads, previews, and deletions with validation and progress handling.
Editable form section for detailed work order fields such as instrument and tuning information.
Lists all work orders with status, customer info, and navigation, including creation via dialog.
UI state prompting users to sign in before accessing work orders.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthStatus.ts: Determines whether the user is authenticated based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, handling login, logout, state management, and identity loading using AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles, theming variables, dark mode rules, and print-specific styling for invoices.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entrypoint setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config defining dark mode, content paths, extended theme settings (fonts, colors, animations), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing versions, existing invoice-printing features, and a pending request to add a proper printable invoice layout.
